question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is 'young'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• immature - not fully developed. (अपरिपक्व)
 
• young - having lived or existed for only a short time. (युवा)
 
• youthful - young or seeming young. (युवा)
 
• childish - of, like, or appropriate to a child.(बचकाना)
 
 
 
• The given blank needs a word that would describe Lin Piao's age.
 
• Thus, option 2 or young is the best fit word for the given blank. 

So the correct passage would be:- *Lin Piao used to absent himself (1) from classes very often and one day (2) the principal of the college made up his (3) mind to expel him. So he sent for the **(4) young** man. Lin arrived just (5)___________ the principal was about to go for lunch. "Is this the time to come?" said the principal, sternly.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Although **young **and **youthful** seem synonymous, **youthful **is mostly used to describe someone who seems to be young. 
 
• Hence, young is more appropriate in the given case.
